messages:
nina: Quick feedback roundup from customer interviews about the billing page: they keep asking why token breakdown colors don't match the CSV. Can we ensure color keys map to CSV columns?
meera: Good catch. CSV currently uses short codes (e.g., prompt_tokens, completion_tokens). We should add header humanization and include color key mapping in the export.
alex: Also request to include project slug in CSV for multi-project orgs. Makes it easier to ingest.
jamal: UX idea: in the chart legend, include a tiny copy icon that copies the CSV header mapping to clipboard. Handy for finance teams.
design-bot: Added header mapping to mock and included a small "Export mapping" icon in the legend. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/map1234/Billing-csv-mapping
meera: Accessibility: legend copy icon needs aria-label like "Copy CSV header mapping" and keyboard focus.
nina: Copy tweak: replace "Token usage" with "Token usage (approx.)" to manage expectations about rounding.
alex: Nice. Also add a small help tooltip linking to doc on token counting methodology.
jamal: One more UX ask: billing page should default to last 30 days but allow quick presets: 7d, 30d, calendar month, ytd. Put the presets as segmented control near the top.
nina: For invoices, customers want a way to flag an invoice as "dispute started" which adds an internal support note and notifies accounts. Maybe add a small kebab menu on invoice rows with actions: Download, Start dispute, View PDF
meera: Good. For auditability, when dispute is started, add a non-editable timestamp and the support agent name.
design-bot: Updated mocks: added segmented timeframe control, CSV header mapping, invoice kebab actions, and dispute flow modal. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/map1234/Billing-csv-mapping
alex: Thanks. Can design add the copy and aria attributes by EOD? We'll triage engineering work after.
